translations.web: I will incline my ear to a proverb. I will solve my riddle on the harp.
translations.bsb: I will incline my ear to a proverb; I will express my riddle with the harp:
translations.kjv: I will incline mine ear to a parable: I will open my dark saying upon the harp.
